offering_description.value: Designs and manufactures school buses and other buses, including diesel, propane, compressed natural gas and electric models. Sells mainly to school districts and contractors through a dealer network. Also sells replacement parts.

primary_products.value: school buses; electric school buses; propane and natural gas buses; commercial and specialty buses; replacement parts

customer_segment.value: B2G: public school districts and municipalities buying buses; B2B: private school bus contractors, fleet operators, and commercial and specialty bus buyers

end_markets.value: school transportation; public transit and shuttle; commercial and specialty transportation

revenue_model.value: product sales: new buses sold through dealers; product sales: aftermarket replacement parts

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: assembles buses from purchased chassis components, engines and powertrains, sold to dealers, school districts and contractors

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Canada and some international markets

specialization.value: related lines: school buses across diesel, propane, natural gas and electric powertrains, plus parts

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: independent school bus dealers selling to districts and contractors; direct sales: some direct sales for parts and large fleet accounts

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: vehicle safety standards from NHTSA and Transport Canada, EPA and CARB emissions rules, state school bus requirements
